verdicts.reason: A: the window graphic is jammed almost against 'Sunday' with only a few pixels of gap, while the date/address block is oversized and crowds the window on the right. The three groups read as one cramped strip, and the top and bottom margins are tight. B: the same left-to-right banner structure, but the window sits in an even gutter between headline and details. The details are properly subordinate to the headline and still readable. Its only real flaw is thin vertical breathing room, which needs minor polish.
